temporal_notes: Larvae and adult mosquitoes collected from January to December 2011
coord_source_text: The study took place in Ndogpassi (3° 48’N 10° 08’E), a district of Douala, which is the largest city in Cameroon
source_text: A total of 757 An. gambiae females were tested for their susceptibility to DDT and pyrethroid insecticides.
